templates.title: Ultimate Camping Checklist
templates.description: A practical camping packing checklist for shelter, cooking, and safety essentials.

items.title: Pack the tent setup
items.description: Bring the tent, stakes, rainfly, and footprint.

items.title: Pack sleeping gear
items.description: Include sleeping bags, pads, and pillows for each camper.

items.title: Bring stove, fuel, and water
items.description: Check fuel levels and water supply before leaving.

items.title: Pack first-aid and light sources
items.description: Bring a stocked first-aid kit, flashlights, and extra batteries.

templates.title: Complete Wedding Planning Checklist
templates.description: A wedding planning checklist organized around budget, venue, and guest milestones.

items.title: Set the budget and guest count
items.description: Decide your target budget and rough guest list before booking vendors.

items.title: Choose a date and venue
items.description: Lock the date once your venue is confirmed.

items.title: Send invitations and track RSVPs
items.description: Make sure guest responses are collected early enough for final headcount.

items.title: Confirm vendors and day-of timeline
items.description: Reconfirm arrival times, payments, and responsibilities for the wedding week.

templates.title: Full Website Launch QA Checklist
templates.description: A richer launch checklist with markdown instructions, subtasks, video review, image proof, file references, and external QA embeds.

items.title: Confirm launch owner, rollback owner, and approval window
items.description: Before anyone ships, make sure the people and the stop/go criteria are explicit.

contents.value:
Capture the launch decision in one place before the deployment starts.

- Name the launch owner.
- Name the rollback owner.
- Define the exact approval window.
- Link the final scope doc or ticket.

**Exit criteria:** everyone knows who can approve, pause, or roll back the launch.

items.title: Review launch walkthrough video
items.description: Use the walkthrough to align on what should be visible after launch.

contents.value: While watching, note any screen, CTA, or user path that does not match the launch scope. Add screenshots to the launch ticket before approving.

items.title: Audit critical pages for content and metadata
items.description: Check the home page, template index, pricing page, and one public template page.

contents.value:
For each critical URL, verify:

1. One clear H1.
2. Accurate title and meta description.
3. Working primary CTA.
4. No placeholder copy.
5. Canonical URL points to the final public URL.

items.title: Attach visual proof for the final hero section
items.description: Keep a reference screenshot so design regressions are obvious later.

items.title: Run performance checks and record the results
items.description: Use the same tool and network profile each time so launch results are comparable.

contents.value: Record the mobile and desktop scores in the launch ticket. If a score regresses, add the blocking asset, script, or route to the post-launch cleanup list.

items.title: Save the launch packet
items.description: Attach the handoff packet so support, marketing, and engineering can refer to the same artifact.
